statement: A Democratic member is elected Speaker of the 120th Congress in a House roll call held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: True if the Clerk of the House roll call held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15 records a Democratic member elected Speaker of the 120th Congress.
failure_condition: No Democratic member has been elected Speaker in a House roll call held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15.

statement: Democrats and independents caucusing with them hold at least 51 US Senate seats between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: True if the Senate.gov party division record shows at least 51 Democrats plus caucusing independents at any point between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15.
failure_condition: Democrats and caucusing independents hold 50 or fewer Senate seats throughout 2027-01-03 to 2027-01-15.
